verdict.rationale: Push sign-in with number matching is a fair question for a 2FA authenticator app, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents TOTP/HOTP code generation, QR or setup-key enrollment, encrypted backups, code sharing, and local lock screens. Nothing shows push-based approvals, number matching, location context, or admin-enforced MFA policies.

support.subject: As an IT admin, push-based sign-in includes phishing defenses — number matching, location context, and admin-enforced MFA policies
